mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 70% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or unchanged in > 50% of instances with positive RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM < -0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or unchanged in > 50% of instances where PAYEMS > 200k & UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong demand in the housing market, which boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or unchanged in > 60% of instances where HOUST MoM > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) coupled with an increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a mismatch between supply and demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive or unchanged in > 50% of instances where GDPC1 QoQ < 0% & INDPRO MoM > 0.5%.
